name: family-button
title: Family Button
description: A square button that springs open into a panel and collapses back. The toggle rotates from plus to close.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown inside the expanded panel.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle button.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the open panel in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the open panel in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the expand and collapse take.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
